en: Improved how soon managed-settings plugins from a git marketplace load on a fresh machine in `claude -p`, SDK and Claude Desktop sessions; a short run may exit up to 30 seconds later
zh: 改进来自 git marketplace 的 managed-settings plugin 在新机器上于 `claude -p`、SDK 和 Claude Desktop session 中的加载速度；短时运行可能最多延迟 30 秒退出
